---
title: "3. Meet the inputs: Mouse59"
---

## Your task

Locate the three TSV files in `data/mouse59/`.

## The three files

| File | Required structure |
|---|---|
| `feature-counts.tsv` | `feature_id`, followed by sample columns of nonnegative integer counts |
| `sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` and `group`, with one row per sample |
| `taxonomy.tsv` | `feature_id` and `taxon`, with one row per feature |

## Dataset details

The original Mouse59GutOTUs.csv had samples in rows and OTUs in columns. Preparation transposed the original counts and renamed Class to group. The taxonomy file repeats OTU IDs as display labels. An OTU is an operational taxonomic unit, a sequence-based feature; its ID does not identify a named species. No filtering, normalization, or rarefaction was applied during preparation.

## Before continuing

Choose one sample ID and locate it in both counts and metadata. Choose one feature ID and locate it in both counts and taxonomy. These identifiers connect the files.
